llm_grading.feedback: Gesture handling is correct: Pinch+Pan run simultaneously via Gesture.Simultaneous, saved-value pattern (savedScale, savedTranslateX/Y) used in onStart to anchor deltas cleanly, and runOnJS correctly bridges UI-thread state back to JS. Soft-clamping in pan is slightly simplified vs the existing subwayMapGestureMath approach but still prevents overscroll. Animation quality is strong: train dots glide with 1200ms withTiming, bottom sheet springs with withSpring (damping=20), and line highlight fades with withTiming — all driven by shared values on the UI thread ensuring 60fps. 7 worklet directives are applied to pure helpers (clampScaleLocal, lerp) and gesture callbacks run on the UI thread with runOnJS for state updates — worklet separation is correct but two imports (interpolateColor, clampTranslate) were declared and never used, a minor smell. Memoization is thorough: all four sub-components (TrainDot, StationBottomSheet, LineSelector, MapCanvas) are React.memo'd, trainScreenPositions is memoised with useMemo, and all callbacks use useCallback. Architecture is clean with typed interfaces, path aliases (@components, @/), COLORS and weightToFontFamily for theme tokens, and clear separation of concerns. Error handling covers ErrorBoundary + FallbackUI, null return from onStationPress, missing handler gracefully falls back to local station data, and try/finally cleans up loading state. Accessibility is excellent: 11 accessibilityLabel annotations, accessibilityRole (button/image/header/tablist/tab), accessibilityState.selected on line chips, accessibilityViewIsModal on the Modal, AccessibilityInfo.announceForAccessibility on line selection, accessibilityHint on station buttons, and accessibilityElementsHidden on decorative line segments.
